mapper.select: SELECT a.gs_id as gsId, a.sb_djid as sbDjid, a.xmid, a.bds, a.bdssm, b.xmzwmc as xmzwmc FROM sys_jsgs a LEFT JOIN sys_jyxm_full b ON a.xmid = b.xmid WHERE a.sb_djid = #{sbDjid} AND a.xmid = #{xmid}

SELECT CONCAT(COALESCE(b.xmzwmc, b.xmdm, CONCAT('项目', a.xmid)), '=', a.bdssm) as jsgs, a.gs_id as gsId, a.xmid, a.bds, COALESCE(b.xmzwmc, b.xmdm) as xmzwmc, a.bdssm FROM sys_jsgs a LEFT JOIN sys_jyxm_full b ON a.xmid = b.xmid WHERE a.sb_djid = #{sbDjid}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_jsgs WHERE sb_djid = #{sbDjid} AND xmid = #{xmid}
